description: This file defines the ProjectMenuConfigurator class for configuring menu items related to the 'Projects' view within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It implements the MenuConfigurator interface and uses traits for module screen helper functions.

classes.name: ProjectMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Class responsible for configuring menu options for the 'Projects' section within the Time module, overriding the screen to 'viewProjects'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'viewProjects' and returns null, configuring the menu for project viewing.
